clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Carendin Halgar gives warlocks runes for summoning a voidwalker. The ritual draws an unbound voidwalker into a circle, where an aspiring warlock can bend it to their will.

Carendin Halgar gives the Runes of Summoning to warlocks ready to command a voidwalker. In the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, Forsaken practitioners study how to manipulate the Nether. A warlock casts the runes in the active summoning circle below Halgar's station. The ritual tears through the Void and draws forth a creature to be overpowered and bound into servitude.
